∀ (query : Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.Query) (extension : Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.Extension), query.start.height = query.target.height → query.start.worldRoot ≠ query.target.worldRoot → Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.verify query extension = Except.error "receipt continuity refused: identity, height, root, suffix or system opening differs"
